args:
# OMPdesk downloaded https://example.test/ad-mac.tar.gz (SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) to /data/tools/.downloads/ad-mac.tar.gz
set -euo pipefail
echo 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa  /data/tools/.downloads/ad-mac.tar.gz' | shasum -a 256 -c -
listing="$(tar -tzf '/data/tools/.downloads/ad-mac.tar.gz' | LC_ALL=C sort | paste -sd' ' -)"
[ "$listing" = 'agent-desktop agent-desktop-macos-helper' ] || { echo "Unexpected archive contents: $listing"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p '/data/tools'
tmp="$(mktemp -d '/data/tools/.agent-desktop.'XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir "$tmp/new"
tar -xzf '/data/tools/.downloads/ad-mac.tar.gz' -C "$tmp/new"
for name in agent-desktop agent-desktop-macos-helper; do
	if [ ! -f "$tmp/new/$name" ] || [ -L "$tmp/new/$name" ]; then echo "$name is not a regular file"; exit 1; fi
	chmod 755 "$tmp/new/$name"
done
chmod 755 "$tmp/new"
want='agent-desktop 1.2.0'
[ "$("$tmp/new/agent-desktop" --version)" = "$want" ] || { echo "The downloaded agent-desktop does not print $want"; exit 1; }
dest='/data/tools/agent-desktop'
if [ -e "$dest" ]; then mv "$dest" "$tmp/old"; fi
mv "$tmp/new" "$dest" || { [ ! -e "$tmp/old" ] || mv "$tmp/old" "$dest"; exit 1; }
if [ "$("$dest/agent-desktop" --version)" != "$want" ]; then
	rm -rf "$dest"
	[ ! -e "$tmp/old" ] || mv "$tmp/old" "$dest"
	echo "agent-desktop in $dest does not print $want"
	exit 1
fi
echo "$want is in $dest"
